name: TC-SM-00: count page addresses listed in each sitemap XML
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/sitemap/SitemapUrlHealth.cy.js#Sitemap - HTTPS URL health TC-SM-00: count page addresses listed in each sitemap XML
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-SM-00
**Title:** Count page addresses listed in each sitemap XML

**Description:**
Read each selected sitemap XML (pages, brands, trucks, dealers by brand, dealers by city, bus pages, buses, bus brands) and count how many page addresses it lists. This does not check the XML file status and does not visit those pages.

**Expected Result:**
Each sitemap XML is logged with how many page addresses it contains. The test always passes.

**Steps:**
1. Open each listed sitemap XML only to read its page address list
2. Count the page addresses in that XML
3. Log the counts — do not fail the test
